title: AutoJoinMod
description: Automatically clicks the Join button in chat so you instantly join games on PvPClub just press J to toggle the mod on and never miss a game again.
body:
## AutoJoin Mod

AutoJoin Mod automatically detects and clicks the Join button in chat messages,
so you get into the game instantly without any manual input.

Designed for use on **PvPClub**.

## How to use

1. Join PvPClub and wait for a game invite to appear in chat
2. Press **J** to toggle the mod on (a message confirms it's active)
3. The mod detects the Join button automatically and clicks it — no action needed

## Details

- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11
- **Toggle key:** J (rebindable in controls menu)
- **Works on:** PvPClub
